title: Corpus black-box runtime fails ABI 0.2 adj/compute baselines
description: Upstream b-dialect-spec-566, dialect §21.1: "the trace runtime and harness at ABI 0.2". corpus/legality/cases/spec-sem2-adj.ll and spec-sem2-compute.ll: without the plugin, both llc O0/O3 on LLVM 18 and 23 exit 87 with FAULT host-segv immediately after ADJ/COMPUTE. A local ABI probe removes ONLY the new budget argument and changes the declaration to ABI v0; the same untouched opaque runtime binary then exits 0 on all four major/codegen combinations for each case. This isolates the runtime ABI mismatch (new ABI passes null budget where old runtime expects env). Gate pre/post plugin also exits 87. Required upstream change: upgrade trace runtime/harness to ABI 0.2; do not change the corpus programs. Gate classification blocked-upstream: bp-c2i, not agreement. Evidence retained in docs/verification.json; no sibling implementation source read.
